name: B-roll shot list
pitch: Create a shot list of B-roll footage to pair with a talking head video script.
instructions: Read the script file from the person's workspace. Identify each topic or scene in order. Search the web for visual references or stock footage ideas for each topic. Build a list pairing each script segment with a suggested B-roll shot or description. Save the shot list as a new page in the workspace. If a topic has no good visual match, note that plainly and move to the next topic. When finished, show the person the completed shot list page.
starters: Here is my script, make a shot list
Can you find B-roll ideas for these topics?
I need a visual plan for my video

examples.ask: Here is my script about gardening tips
examples.does: Reads the script, searches for gardening visuals, and returns a shot list pairing each tip with a B-roll idea.
Looks up commute visuals and returns a list of shot suggestions for each section.

skills.name: build-shot-list
skills.description: Turn script topics into a B-roll shot list.
skills.body: 1. Open the script file using file_read. 2. List each topic or paragraph in the order it appears. 3. For each topic, use web_search to find stock footage, video clips, or visual ideas that match. 4. Write one sentence per topic describing a suitable B-roll shot or noting if no good match exists. 5. Use make_page to create a new document titled 'B-roll shot list' and paste the list into it. 6. Show the finished page to the person.

readme:
# B-roll shot list

Create a shot list of B-roll footage to pair with a talking head video script. Reads the script, searches the web for visual ideas, and outputs a page with one suggested shot per script segment.

Needs: file_read to open the script, web_search for visual ideas, make_page to save the list. Will not write to any other location or pay for stock footage.
